title: Booking Flow Handoff Simulator — Gemini model variant
description: A developer-operated Gemini rerun of the canonical Booking Flow Handoff Simulator brief, preserved as an auditable PathForge Labs model variant rather than a community fork.

comparison_basis.opening_prompt_exact: Can you make me a self-contained booking-flow handoff simulator a solo service business can save and use before automating customer messages?
acceptance_criteria: Let the user model booking intake questions, service slots, confirmations, branch conditions, and failure handoffs.
Run realistic booking scenarios and clearly distinguish sent, skipped, interrupted, and failed steps.
Evaluate the simulated transcript against a visible implementation or compliance checklist.
Provide truthful copy and download controls for an implementation-ready handoff receipt.
Produce one complete self-contained HTML file that is immediately usable in a browser.
Operate offline with no external APIs, hosted generation, CDNs, remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or fragile dependencies.
Avoid unsafe HTML sinks, eval-like execution, inline event handlers, modal dialogs, and deprecated clipboard handling.
Avoid page-level horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 and at desktop width.
Keep essential controls visible, keyboard or touch reachable, and truthful about their current state.
Preserve exact prompt, response, source, and artifact-version evidence for the run.
comparison_basis.adaptive_repair_policy: Preserve and score the first real artifact. Continue only when verification proves a concrete defect or a source-capture failure; use the same source session and model; name the observed defect in ordinary language; preserve every real artifact version; stop as soon as the artifact passes; prefer no more than three total prompts and go beyond three only for a documented concrete lane reason such as a verification-proven regression, truncation, or mechanical capture failure.
comparison_basis.independence_note: Gemini received the invariant brief in a fresh session and was not shown the historical implementation, screenshots, source code, or another provider's output.

agent_notes: Model settings: Gemini web; Pro mode.
PathForge Labs provenance: developer-operated comparison run; not a user, community fork, vote, bookmark, or engagement event.
Prompt count: 3. The first repair replaced nine inline event handlers; the second verification-driven repair replaced the generic chat widget with the contracted configurable handoff simulator.
All three real artifact versions are preserved under public/artifacts. The third artifact is the default selectable version for this model run.

Final verification passed all ten fixed contract checks, static safety, JavaScript parsing, two booking scenarios covering SENT, SKIPPED, INTERRUPTED, and FAILED outcomes, checklist and receipt export, desktop rendering, and measured 390x844 no-overflow checks.

artifact_version_notes.disposition: Preserved first response; not the default because verification found nine prohibited inline event handlers.
Preserved second response; safe but not default because it remained a generic chat widget without configurable flow steps, outcome states, or a checklist.
Final verified Gemini artifact and default version; all ten contract checks passed.

verification_notes: The final artifact's single inline script parsed successfully.

Static scan found no external URL, remote dependency, fetch, XHR, unsafe HTML sink, eval-like execution, inline handler, document.write, modal API, deprecated clipboard handling, or negative letter spacing.
Direct verification added a third intake question and service slot, exercised deposit-off and deposit-on branches, and produced SENT, SKIPPED, INTERRUPTED, and FAILED outcomes.
All four deployment checklist items were selectable and the generated 861-character handoff receipt preserved configuration, scenario statuses, and checklist results.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors; the mobile configure view remained readable and touch reachable.

notes: Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors; the customer trigger, custom reply, and local transcript-download control worked.
The first artifact contained nine prohibited inline event-handler attributes.

Against the ten-check contract it also lacked configurable intake, service-slot, confirmation, branch, and failure-handoff steps; explicit sent/skipped/interrupted/failed outcomes; and a visible implementation checklist.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors, and the static hard-gate scan passed.

Direct scenarios verified editable intake questions and service slots, deposit branching and failure handoffs, all four required outcome states, a visible four-item implementation checklist, and an 861-character receipt containing configuration, statuses, and checklist results.
All four project-specific checks and all six shared production checks passed.

steps.title: Build the invariant booking-flow simulator brief
steps.prompt_exact: Can you make me a self-contained booking-flow handoff simulator a solo service business can save and use before automating customer messages?
steps.response_summary: Gemini produced the first complete one-file booking-flow simulator artifact.
steps.notes: Preserved as the unmodified first artifact. Static verification found nine inline event handlers.

steps.title: Replace inline event handlers
steps.prompt_exact: The saved file uses inline onclick and onkeypress handlers, which my public viewer rejects. Replace every inline event handler with safe addEventListener wiring, keep the same booking simulator and download flow, and return the complete updated self-contained HTML.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned the complete simulator with addEventListener wiring.
steps.continuation_reason: Verification-proven defect: the first artifact used nine inline onclick/onkeypress handlers rejected by the public viewer.
steps.notes: Current safe artifact. Contract-completeness verification still requires a same-session repair before release.

steps.title: Restore the full configurable handoff contract
steps.prompt_exact: After checking the saved revision against what this handoff simulator needs to do, it is still only a chat practice widget. It does not let me configure the booking flow or inspect handoff outcomes. Turn it into a real handoff simulator: let me add and edit booking intake questions and service slots, define confirmation and deposit steps with simple conditions or branches and failure handoffs, run a scenario that labels each step SENT, SKIPPED, INTERRUPTED, or FAILED, show a visible implementation checklist, and copy or download a handoff receipt containing the scenario, step statuses, and checklist results. Keep it offline in one HTML file, preserve safe addEventListener and createElement/textContent rendering, and make it work at 390px without horizontal overflow. Return the complete updated HTML.
